name: Moon Corona
description:
About This Game

BLEND DECKBUILDING WITH STORY-DRIVEN CHOICES

The depth of card strategy? The immersion of role-playing? The weight of fateful choices?

No need to choose—here, you can have it all.

AWAKEN IN AN ANCIENT TEMPLE AND BEGIN YOUR QUEST

The hero, long asleep in the ancient temple, has reached the day of departure!

Collect scattered cards across the Duchy of Reinhart, build your own deck to grow stronger, gather the whispers along your journey to unlock the story, and set off on an adventure to uncover the lost truth and redemption hidden within Moon Crown!

TRAVERSE CASTLES, WILDERNESS, AND FORGOTTEN DUNGEONS

Traverse castles, wilderness, villages, cities, cathedrals, and dungeons—each place bears the mark of lost memories

Trigger encounters in exploration, rewrite the story, and unlock forgotten inheritances

The world is not only for you to walk through. It awaits your intervention in the course of its fate

FORGE A CUSTOM DECK AND SHAPE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE

Hundreds of cards with distinct effects—mix and match freely, with no fixed templates

Class-exclusive cards: define your combat style and unleash unique combos

Universal combo cards: cover weaknesses, break class boundaries, and build limitless possibilities

Melee mage, high-defense hunter, agile berserker… if you can imagine it, you can build it

UNLOCK 40+ DISTINCT CLASSES AND BUILD WITHOUT LIMITS

Start from five base classes and step onto the path to godhood across the Reinhart continent—

Barbarian, Elemental Master, Demolition Maniac… define your own way with over 40 advanced classes!

There are no standard answers here—only your one-of-a-kind playstyle

MASTER MULTI-LAYER TACTICAL COMBAT WITH SKILLFUL MOVEMENT

Part-breaking system: target weak points, shatter armor, and turn the tide in an instant

Movement-based combat: positioning, dodging, terrain kills, spacing and kiting—execution is strategy

Use factions against each other: win with wit rather than brute strength

UNRAVEL THE LOST TRUTH BEHIND REINHART’S SHADOW WAR

The crown and the church wage a shadow war; divine grace and curses coexist; magic clashes with steel; chaos and order spiral in a cycle…

And the ordinary people swept up by the torrent—your choices will become their only light. But remember:

Not every fate can be saved, just as not every darkness longs to be illuminated…

【Open your eyes in the ancient temple—add to your wishlist! Let’s adventure together】

Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.
